name: STIHL MS 231
blurb: 42.6 cm3. The MS 231 / MS 251 manual approves three cutting attachments: .325" at 1.3 mm, .325" at 1.6 mm, and 3/8" PICCO at 1.3 mm. It prints no drive-link count. The US 2025 catalog chart does not name the MS 231.
notice: Drive-link counts are not in this manual. The MS 251 has its own page from the US catalog, which does print counts for the Wood Boss. Do not copy those counts onto an MS 231 until the bar stamp matches.
intro: The MS 231 is the smaller engine in a manual STIHL titles for the MS 231 and the MS 251 together (0458-737-8221-C). In that manual the MS 231 is 42.6 cm3, bore 42.5 mm, stroke 30 mm, 2.0 kW (2.7 hp) at 10,000 rpm. The MS 251 and MS 251 C in the same section are 45.6 cm3, bore 44 mm, the same 30 mm stroke, 2.2 kW (3.0 hp) at 10,000 rpm. Idle is 2,800 rpm. Dry weight without the cutting attachment is 4.9 kg for the MS 231 and for the MS 251, and 5.2 kg for the MS 251 C with ErgoStart and the quick chain tensioner. Fuel capacity is 390 cm3 (0.39 l). The oiler is a fully automatic speed-controlled pump with a rotary piston, and the oil tank is 200 cm3 (0.2 l). The spark plug is an NGK CMR6H or Bosch USR 4AC, gap 0.5 mm. The cutting-attachment section is written once for the whole manual, and it is the reason an MS 231 and an MS 251 can leave the shop on different chains. STIHL says the listed combinations meet CSA Z62.3, and that the actual cutting length can be shorter than the specified length. There are three Rollomatic E systems. The first is .325" (8.25 mm) with a 1.3 mm groove, cutting lengths 35, 40 and 45 cm, 11-tooth nose sprocket, chains Rapid Micro Pro (23 RM) type 3693 and Rapid Micro 3 Pro (23 RM3) type 3695, drive-link gauge 1.3 mm. The second is the same .325" pitch, the same 35, 40 and 45 cm lengths and the same 11-tooth nose, but the groove is 1.6 mm and the chains are Rapid Micro 3 (26 RM3) type 3634 and Rapid Duro 3 (26 RD3) type 3667. The third is 3/8" P (9.32 mm), which is STIHL's low-profile PICCO pitch, groove 1.3 mm, cutting lengths 30, 35, 40 and 45 cm, 9-tooth nose, chains Picco Micro 3 (63 PM3) type 3636, Picco Super 3 (63 PS3) type 3616 and Picco Duro 3 (63 PD3) type 3612. STIHL's identification chart reads 1.3 mm as .050" (mark 3) and 1.6 mm as .063" (mark 6). A 1.3 mm chain will not fill a 1.6 mm groove, and a 1.6 mm chain will not enter a 1.3 mm groove. Counting drive links cannot tell those two .325" bars apart, because the manual never prints a count. The sprocket has to change with the pitch. The manual lists a 7-tooth sprocket for .325" and a 6-tooth sprocket for 3/8" P, and then lists a 6-tooth sprocket for .325" as well. Both .325" tooth counts are in the same paragraph, so this page does not pick one. The nose sprocket is a third match: 11 teeth on the .325" bars, 9 teeth on the 3/8" P bars. The sharpening table in the same manual assigns a 4.0 mm (5/32") round file to 3/8" P and a 4.8 mm (3/16") round file to .325". Micro teeth, and the manual's examples include 63 PM3 and 26 RM3, are sharpened at 30 degrees with a 75 degree side plate. Super teeth, example 63 PS3, stay at 30 degrees with a 60 degree side plate. A ripping chain, designation containing X, is 10 degrees. The US 2025 Full Line catalog's saw-chain chart does not name the MS 231. It does name the MS 251 Wood Boss and the MS 251 C-BE in a block with the MS 250, and that block prints drive-link counts (63 PM3 at 44, 50, 55 and 61, and .325" rows at 62 and 68). Those counts belong on the MS 251 page, which is built from that chart. They are not printed in the MS 231 manual, and they are not repeated here as if the manual had stated them. Order the MS 231 by the pitch and the millimeter groove on the bar, then count the drive links on that bar. The manual's ordering section asks for the model, the serial number, and the guide-bar and chain part numbers from the saw, because those parts are wear items.

bars.label: .325", 1.3 mm groove
bars.note: Manual section 33.7.1 and 33.7.4: Rollomatic E, cutting lengths 35, 40 and 45 cm, pitch .325" (8.25 mm), groove and drive-link gauge 1.3 mm, 11-tooth nose. Chains 23 RM type 3693 and 23 RM3 type 3695. The 14/16/18 inch labels are the usual called lengths for 35/40/45 cm; the manual prints centimeters. No drive-link count. Gauge .050" is STIHL mark 3 for 1.3 mm. File 4.8 mm (3/16") from the manual's .325" row in the sharpening table. Sprockets listed for .325": 7-tooth and 6-tooth.

bars.label: .325", 1.6 mm groove
bars.note: Manual section 33.7.2 and 33.7.5: same 35, 40 and 45 cm cutting lengths and 11-tooth nose, groove and drive-link gauge 1.6 mm. Chains 26 RM3 type 3634 and 26 RD3 type 3667. Gauge .063" is STIHL mark 6 for 1.6 mm. Same 3/16" file as the other .325" row. This is not the 1.3 mm bar.

bars.label: 3/8" PICCO, 1.3 mm groove
bars.note: Manual section 33.7.3 and 33.7.6: 3/8" P (9.32 mm), cutting lengths 30, 35, 40 and 45 cm, groove 1.3 mm, 9-tooth nose. Chains 63 PM3 type 3636, 63 PS3 type 3616 and 63 PD3 type 3612. Pitch on this row is 3/8" low profile because the manual's designation is 3/8" P, STIHL PICCO, not standard 3/8". File 4.0 mm (5/32") from the manual's 3/8" P sharpening row. Sprocket listed for 3/8" P: 6-tooth. No drive-link count.

sources.title: MS 231, MS 251 instruction manual 0458-737-8221-C: engine specs and cutting attachment section 33.7 (three bar systems, chain types, sprockets) plus the sharpening-tool table
STIHL Saw Chain Selection and Identification chart, specifications as of 1 October 2017: gauge mark 3 = .050" (1.3 mm), mark 6 = .063" (1.6 mm)

sources_note: STIHL MS 231 / MS 251 instruction manual 0458-737-8221-C, read 12 Nov 2026. Drive-link counts are absent from that manual, so none are printed. The .050" and .063" labels for 1.3 mm and 1.6 mm are STIHL's 1 October 2017 identification chart. The US 2025 catalog chart does not name the MS 231; the MS 251 page is the one that uses that chart.
